name: PR Overview shows the seeded brief, keeps it on reload and opens a Review focus entry on Files changed
description: PR #482 carries a seeded brief row (server/src/db/seed-brief.ts), so the Overview tab renders the summary, the risk areas and the Review focus list with no model call. Reloading keeps the summary and shows no 'Generate brief' button (absence is asserted with `wait --fn`, the suite has no negative locator). Activating the seeded `src/config.ts:12` entry lands on `?tab=diff&file=src/config.ts&line=12` and renders the src/config.ts patch (`rateLimitWindowMs: 60_000` is an added line there). Deterministic commands only, no model key.
